pendentes.alt: Sala clara com janelas abertas em paredes opostas, cortinas leves de linho balançando com a brisa e plantas no canto
pendentes.pedido: A bright, airy living room with tall open windows on two opposite walls, sheer white linen curtains gently lifted by a breeze. Light oak floor, a low beige sofa, a woven jute rug and a large potted plant near the window. Soft morning daylight, green garden visible through both windows. Interior design photography, wide angle, eye level.
